title: Polypous
summary: POL'YPOUS, adjective [from polypus.] Having the nature of the polypus; having many feet or roots, like the polypus; as a polypous concretion.

inlines.v: POL'YPOUS, adjective [from polypus.] Having the nature of the polypus; having many feet or roots, like the polypus; as a polypous concretion.
